svg.title: personagent reply decision
svg.desc: A calm macOS-style terminal window shows personagent reading a group chat and structured model output, then choosing to send a natural reply, save a memory, answer with a sticker, or remain silent with PASS.

g.text: mike finally got the build green
sam spent 3 hours on this and ctrl+z'd it into the void
"rip. take five before you go back in",
rip. take five before you go back in
sam i'm moving to berlin next month, signed the lease today
"wait for real? congrats. is the flat near anything",
wait for real? congrats. is the flat near anything
mike they want it by friday tho
jules @bot how do we feel about that
Called by name; a sticker fits the room.
